prompt: Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset type: thesis-grade platform mechanism figure. Generate a clean academic infographic on a white background showing a cyclical teacher course sharing and updating mechanism. Six steps arranged in a loop or ring: 本地创建课程, 导入与整理课节实验, 上传课程, 课堂使用, 课后修订, 拉取更新与再分享. Use strong numbered badges 1 to 6, clear arrows forming a cycle, and one center label reading 课程持续更新闭环 if text quality allows. If Chinese rendering is weak, keep only the six step labels and numbers. Visual style must be formal, systematic, platform-oriented, suitable for thesis or proposal, no people, no logos, no watermark, no clutter.
